annotations.title: Estimate temperatures inside a sealed enclosure

description: Steady-state air temperature inside a SEALED enclosure and each part's junction temperature in that air, from the power dissipated inside, the enclosure's size, wall thickness and wall thermal conductivity. Each part's theta_JA and maximum junction temperature are yours, from its datasheet. When film coefficients are not given the answer is a low-to-high range over a stated generic natural-convection range and verdicts rest on the hot end. A one-dimensional screening estimate, NOT a simulation: no vents or fan, one air temperature inside, no hot spots, no sun load. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

blocked_faces.description: Faces that cannot shed heat, such as the one on a table.

other_power_w.description: Power dissipated inside that is not in parts.

ref.description: Reference designator on the board, for example 'U3'.

wall_conductivity_w_mk.description: Wall material's thermal conductivity in W/(m*K), from its datasheet.
